name: Messaging Alerts Integration for WooCommerce
author: smsgatewaycenter

sections.description:
Boost customer engagement on your WooCommerce store using automated messaging alerts for order-related events. This plugin integrates with a third-party messaging API (WabaAPI.com) to deliver real-time notifications to both store administrators and customers.

Customize your message templates, manage delivery logs, and send bulk updates to user groups – all from within your WordPress dashboard.

Key Features:
– Supports both national and international messaging via third-party API.
– Automated alerts for WooCommerce order status changes.
– Customizable message templates per status.
– Keyword-based auto-responses via third-party service.
– View and manage delivery logs (DLR).
– Send bulk messages to predefined user segments.
– Compatible with WooCommerce Version 8.2.2 and above.

Supported Events:
– Order statuses: Completed, Processing, Pending Payment, On Hold, Cancelled, Refunded, Failed.
– Customer actions: New registration, password reset, product review, profile updates.
– Admin alerts for customer events.

3rd Party Service Integration
This plugin utilizes a third-party service provided by WabaAPI for sending messages via API.

  • Service Provider: WabaAPI
  • Terms of Use: WabaAPI Terms
  • Privacy Policy: WabaAPI Privacy
sections.installation:
WordPress Dashboard

  1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  4. Click Upload Plugin, select the zip file, and install.
  5. Activate the plugin.
  6. You will see a new “Messaging Alerts” menu in your admin sidebar.

FTP Method

  1. Unzip the plugin folder.
  2. Upload it to wp-content/plugins/ on your server via FTP.
  3. Log in to your dashboard, go to Plugins, and activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

It sends automated message alerts for various order-related events on your WooCommerce store using a third-party API.

Is the plugin free?

Yes, it’s free to use with all features included. However, you’ll need a valid API account from the external service provider.

Can I customize the alert messages?

Yes, you can fully customize message templates for each event from the admin panel.

What events are supported for messaging?

Order completion, payment pending, cancellation, refunds, account registration, password reset, and more.

Are international messages supported?

Yes, international messaging is supported if your API account allows it.

Does the plugin offer message delivery tracking?

Yes, you can track and manage delivery reports from within the dashboard.
